entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Hey, I saw on the forum! Nice job[n]sticking it to that stalker!

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: My Phantom Aficionado Website[n]came in handy, didn't it?

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: It's OK, you don't have to[n]say it. I know deep down in[n]my heart that it was useful.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Anyway, I'm in Shibuya right now.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: I'd love it if you could come hear[n]me out about your future actions!

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: I'll be waiting at the diner in[n]Shibuya. You gotta swing by!
I've obtained intel on a target.[n]Perhaps I should see what everyone[n]has to say at the hideout...
